title: Home Assistant
summary: Your Home Assistant on the deck: your own dashboard, favourites and rooms.
description: A client of your own Home Assistant server on the local network, signed in by scanning a QR code with a phone. Your stored dashboard drawn natively (entities, sensor and weather cards), then tiles for favourites and each area, with Home Assistant's icons and state colours. Switch a light, run a scene; locks and garage doors ask first. Greyed when offline. Not affiliated with the Home Assistant project.
